title: Cook and Hold Oven - Ventless (208V, Single Phase) x4 CNC

onscreen_lines.desc: Cook & Hold Oven – Ventless Specification (208V, Single Phase) Approved brand: FWE, Metro or approved equal General Description: Provide a commercial low-temperature cook-and-hold oven designed for cooking, holding, and reheating. Unit shall operate on 208V single-phase power and include a ventless condensation system allowing installation without a hood, subject to local code approval. Ventless System Requirements Integrated condensation system designed to capture and cool vapor from the cook cycle No external ventilation ducting required System shall manage moisture discharge internally and route condensate to a removable drip tray Unit shall meet local authority requirements for ventless operation Maximum cook temperature shall be adjustable to comply with ventless restrictions Low-emission design suitable for placement in standard foodservice areas Construction Requirements Stainless steel exterior and interior, minimum 18-gauge Coved interior corners for sanitation Fully welded, single-body construction High-density insulation on all sides Heavy-duty hinges and magnetic-style door latch Field-reversible door Removable stainless drip tray Recessed side hand grips for mobility Tray / Pan Capacity (Per Compartment) 6 trays/pans at 4.5" spacing Compatible with: 18" x 26" full-size sheet pans 12" x 20" hotel pans 14" x 18" pans GN 2/1 and GN 1/1 pans Adjustable/removable tray slides Uprights punched on 1.5" centers for spacing flexibility Heating & Controls Low-velocity forced-air heating system Incoloy-type heating elements Automatic switch from cook cycle to hold cycle Cook temperature range: 90°F – 350°F (adjustable for ventless compliance) Hold temperature range: 90°F – 250°F LED temperature display Timer-based or probe-based cooking capability Preheat and pause functions Control panel over-temperature protection Condensate tray must be accessible for daily emptying Ventless operation allows placement without a Type I or Type II hood Electrical Requirements 208V, single-phase Rear-mounted grounded power cord Complies with NEC and local electrical codes Mobility Four casters: two rigid, two swivel with brake Polyurethane tires Reinforced caster plates welded to frame Warranty & Submittals Manufacturer’s standard equipment warranty Contractor shall provide product data, wiring diagrams, and installation documentation
onscreen_lines.note: Full height ovens Please hold pricing for a year.
